init.missing: missing prerequisites: {list}. Install them and run `llm-memory init` again.
init.auth.browser: Opening the GitHub sign-in in your browser (device flow). Follow the instructions, then come back here.
init.auth.required: GitHub sign-in is required: run `gh auth login --web` and then `llm-memory init` again.
init.ask.sources: Also back up the raw transcripts to a second private repository? (they may contain secrets in plain text)
init.vault.existing: {vault} is already a git repository, keeping it
init.vault.notEmpty: {vault} exists and is not empty; choose another folder or an empty one

init.vault.cloning: {full} already exists on GitHub: cloning it (second machine)
init.probe.failed: the repository refuses pushes to refs/locks/* ({detail}). The single-writer lock needs them: check the repository rulesets, then run `llm-memory init` again.
init.sources.cloning: {full} already exists on GitHub: cloning it
init.sources.warning: WARNING: the transcript repository holds raw session logs that may contain secrets in plain text. Keep it private; never make it public or share it.
init.schedule.ok: scheduled: ingest daily at {ingest}; lint weekly on {lint}
init.schedule.notEnabled: timer units written but not enabled (no systemd user session: {detail}). Run `systemctl --user enable --now llm-memory-ingest.timer llm-memory-lint.timer` from a graphical session, or run `llm-memory ingest` by hand.
init.schedule.unsupported: no scheduler on {platform}: run `llm-memory ingest` and `llm-memory lint` by hand (see docs/macos.md)
init.push.deferred: push deferred (offline?): the next session start or scheduled run will push
init.done: Done. The memory vault is ready at {vault}.
init.next:
Next steps:
  1. Open `claude` in any project and finish a short session: the transcript appears in sources/.
  2. `llm-memory status` shows the state; `llm-memory ingest` runs the ingest now.
  3. Schedule or language: edit memory.config.json in the vault, then `llm-memory repair`.
backfill.result: backfill: {copied} copied, {skipped} already present, {tooLarge} too large, {noCwd} without project, out of {scanned}
status.notConfigured: not configured on this machine: run `llm-memory init`
repair.done: repaired: hooks, skills, memory links and scheduled runs re-registered
uninstall.done: removed: hooks, scheduled runs, skill links and machine config. Kept: the vault ({vault}), its sources/ and the memory links.
init.identity.failed: git has no user.name/user.email and the GitHub account could not be read; run: git config --global user.name ... and user.email ...
